_comment: Skeleton culture definition. Rename the file and drop it under millenaire-custom/cultures/<your_culture_id>/culture.json.
_id_rules: Culture ID (the directory name) must be lowercase alphanumeric: [a-z0-9]+. No underscores, no hyphens.

travel_book._comment: Category keys shown in the Travel Book. Reuse keys from an existing culture (see cultures/norman/culture.json) unless you add new ones via language files.
